# Track green block count vs hull position. Move RIGHT and observe.
def state():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    greens=[n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']>=20]
    hull=[n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='b']
    hc=None
    for h in hull:
        bs=h['boundary']; cs=[b[1] for b in bs]
        hc=(min(cs),max(cs))
    return len(greens), sum(n['pixels'] for n in greens), hc

print('before RIGHT:', state())
res=action(['RIGHT'])
print('after RIGHT:', state())
print('board_changed:',res.get('board_changed'))
